Crawlmind — full product flow
Landing -> Get Started -> Auth -> App Workspace -> Chat (Standard/Agent) -> Settings

Green accent = dark mode. Clay/terracotta = light mode. Toggle theme via the Theme tweak on each artboard.

Items marked COMING SOON (API Keys, Connected accounts) are not backed by the current API yet — see backend/main.py. Everything else maps to real endpoints (auth, knowledge-bases, crawl, index, chat/stream, agent/chat/stream, models).
